items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 30 April 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred close to northeast Scotland extends a ridge covering much of Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East 5 or 6, decreasing East or Southeast 4 or 5 later this morning or early afternoon, then decreasing 3 or 4 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers inn west later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 3 or 4, veering South or Southwest tomorrow afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, risk of mist patches for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers, poor in any mist patches.
